svg.aria-label: macOS on Intel Raptor Lake-P: subsystem status and live commit telemetry

g.text: ◆ MISSION // macOS ON INTEL RAPTOR LAKE-P
13th-gen Intel laptop iGPUs have no macOS driver. Bringing one up natively, subsystem by subsystem.
Docs: correct the round-42 probe counts
REF RIG: ASUS TUF F15 // i7-13620H // UHD GRAPHICS A7A8 // EXPERIMENTAL, TESTED ON ONE MACHINE
